title: Simcenter 3D workflows and connector status

Siemens

Simcenter 3D

Simcenter 3D supports multidisciplinary simulation modelling, solution and results analysis.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare a multiphysics model

Use the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended Simcenter 3D preview, prepare a multiphysics model; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Run a configured solution

Start from the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended Simcenter 3D preview, run a configured solution; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Compare engineering responses

Begin with the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended Simcenter 3D preview, compare engineering responses; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
